query: Run an accessibility scan on https://www.facilitron.com/resources/toolkit and tell me if it's WCAG compliant.
expected_behavior: Resolves the single URL as the target and selects WCAG 2.1 AA as the default level
Delegates the run to the a11y-scan-runner subagent via the Task tool rather than running pa11y or axe directly
Relays the runner's findings grouped by issue type with severity counts
Preserves the caveat that automated scanning catches only ~30-40% of WCAG issues, so a clean scan is not proof of compliance
